title: Bounded small-trade owner service removes avoidable executor and queue-task churn

decision.measured_bottleneck: Mixed retained trade interval67500..68684 overflows the unchanged512-frame upstream queue with both baseline and direct queued-get alone. Small native decode/reduce work is a minority of inclusive process wall time; per-frame executor dispatch/task/shield and queue-wait scheduling let the reader outrun the consumer.
decision.change: Consume queued frames directly; use asyncio.timeout only when empty. Decode/reduce trade payloads at most4096bytes inline in the sole owner and yield after each delivered atomic transaction. Keep every book frame and larger trade payload offloaded with existing shield/join cancellation handling.
decision.bounds: No receive count/byte, recorder count/byte, depth, payload acceptance, or timeout limits changed.4096bytes is an execution-placement threshold, not a new rejection limit.
decision.scope_of_claim: Offline finite evidence demonstrates the avoidable service bottleneck and lossless retained workloads; it does not establish that a new sustained live capture will be complete.

workload_contract.normal_and_buffered: Three retained multi-trade-source windows17500..19053,58500..60320,67500..68684. Paced cases preserve positive receive gaps capped at10ms (not original real-time). Buffered cases expose the same actual bytes immediately in original cross-source order.
workload_contract.production_paths: Mixed schedule calls the production _receive then sleep(0) receive/yield sequence, production _consume/_process, original adapters/reducers/normalization, and real threaded Recorder. Separate edges exercise unmodified production _reader with a buffered socket iterator.
workload_contract.simultaneous_books: The first987 raw frames (ordinals below1000) exercise all12 source streams and original native Binance REST5000-depth bootstrap plus depth deltas and Hyperliquid books/trades concurrently. No book was truncated.
workload_contract.arrays: Largest retained Hyperliquid trade array29134bytes/106trades and largest retained<=4096-byte array3880bytes. Each is offered20times, retaining original payload bytes and normal production dedup behavior.
workload_contract.regression_envelope: 128 actual distinct ETH trades from failed ordinals68164..68294 with an explicit16-item upstream bound isolates consumer-visible loss without pinning the production default.

parity_interpretation: raw_exact compares every persisted RawFrame (all identity/clock/payload fields) to the raw callback input; raw_input_order_exact additionally compares original stream/payload merge order.

normalized_exact compares all persisted EventEnvelope fields to delivered callback events. Checkpoint and auxiliary comparisons use exact native checkpoint objects/observer bytes against normalized replay, with raw and normalized replay state/book hashes equal for every completed corrected case.

The original workload native_trades_exact field compared a global source-order trade list to cross-stream delivery order and did not account for duplicate exclusion; it is retained unchanged, not used as a financial parity gate. The separate native_trade_parity comparator preserves order within each stream, applies declared dedup identities, and compares exact Trade objects plus canonical wire SHA256. All completed corrected cases match; both original and direct-only overflow cases fail, as expected.
Different output sessions have new identities and actual clocks, so hashes are compared inside each capture, not asserted equal across separate original/corrected sessions.
diagnostic_setup_correction: First auxiliary parity-digest run rejected an unsupported wire dict; final run serializes sorted immutable tuples. No production change was made for that diagnostic error.

limitations: Finite retained-source diagnostics, not a sustained network capture or UI browser proof. All source failures and incomplete output markings are preserved.

Mixed burst workload uses the production receive boundary with the reader receive/yield schedule, not independently timed real sockets. Separate single-source edge workloads run the actual reader. Twelve-source native-depth concurrency is covered by the bootstrap workload, not an exact replay of all scheduling at live failure time.
Paced10ms cap compresses idle gaps; buffered delivery is a deliberate finite backlog, not a claim about original socket timing. Hardware/GIL/writer contention affects service times.

Largest retained inline array timing is an observed sample, not a universal CPU deadline. The conservative byte threshold bounds input work; large arrays retain worker isolation. Small-array heartbeat worst interval increased from6.40ms to13.44ms in these single runs; no latency percentile or UI SLO proof is claimed.
No pytest, builds, lint, formatters, or live network ran. Parent owns union gates, browser proof and fresh sustained public capture.

Output capture verification flags were disabled for these bounded internal readback comparisons; upstream incomplete source storage verification was performed by parent. Exact raw/normalized/native/checkpoint/aux comparisons are recorded separately.
